I've been adding my weight daily but not food these last four weeks until today. I was shocked at the update. It's SO hard. The search is at the bottom and not top. The answers on the next page sure the search again at the bottom. Everything looks different and difficult.  Why oh why did you have to update a perfect app. Unfortunately I paid already for an entire year.
